messages:
alex.sales: Quick handoff — Guardian Agency trial started today. POC: elena@guardian.gov. Needs SAML SSO (email + agency_id), customer-managed KMS, and audit webhooks into their SIEM. Trial 30d; renewal ~60d. Flagging renewal risk if privacy/KMS not resolved.

maria.cs: Ill own CS. Success criteria from customer: SSO + SCIM, KMS managed by customer, webhook delivery >=99.5%. Any repro/logs attached?

alex.sales: Uploaded payloads to ticket #70071. Errors seen: {"error":"MsgSizeExceeded"} and intermittent 500s. They asked for Private vs Dedicated cost delta.

leah.support: Picking up #70071. Triage: our edge proxy is rejecting payloads >1MB. Short-term mitigation: ask them to gzip or chunk requests. Long-term: raise proxy limit or support streaming ingestion. Added curl repro and raw payload to ticket.

sam.eng: cc @leah.support @maria.cs  I can take engineering triage. With a repro I can scope: hotfix config bump (~24h) or streaming ingestion (~48-72h). If they require Private, infra lead time ~3w. Please attach exact curl and sample.json.

rory.finance: Ill prepare a two-option estimate (Private one-time + infra vs Dedicated reserved monthly) and post by EOD tomorrow.

maria.cs: Owner matrix: CS=@maria.cs, Support=@leah.support, Eng=@sam.eng, Sales=@alex.sales, Finance=@rory.finance. Action items: 1) Support attach repro; 2) Eng scope hotfix vs streaming; 3) CS confirm KMS key routing and required SAML attributes; 4) Finance price two-options. Check-in scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Ticket #70071 created by leah.support. SLA flagged: 24h response requested. :rotating_light:

alex.sales: I told Elena we aim for a 24h hotfix if repro is solid. Messaging will stay conservative until eng confirms.

maria.cs: Also logged DOC-778 to simplify gov KMS/SSO checklist based on customer feedback. Ill update this thread after the check-in.
